title: Preserve Claude shell placement after qualified Bash escaped-quote test filters
outcome: A qualified literal-pipe command with escaped Bash quotes does not unnecessarily lose the remembered shell directory for later commands whose runtime reports no cwd.
acceptance: Add a Claude-provenance cwd-None witness that runs a supported escaped-quote literal-pipe test and then a later test in the same session, proving both retain the correct placement.
Use the qualified command reading for shell-move tracking or document a precise supported one-call workaround; retain conservative refusal for actual untracked directory changes.
Focused validation and independent review cover the final fix.
